name: MS Roald Amundsen

seo.title: MS Roald Amundsen: HX's Hybrid Expedition Ship in Antarctica
seo.description: MS Roald Amundsen, HX's hybrid powered expedition ship built in 2019 for polar waters: 490 guests, every cabin outside, the Science Center and suites with hot tubs. James sailed her in Antarctica in 2020.

tagline: The hybrid expedition ship James sailed to Antarctica in 2020.
answer: MS Roald Amundsen is HX Expeditions' hybrid powered expedition ship, built in 2019 at Kleven Yards in Norway for polar waters. She carries up to 490 guests; every cabin is an outside cabin, half have private balconies, and the aft suites have outdoor hot tubs. HX says electric propulsion cuts her fuel use and CO2 emissions by 20 percent.
overview: HX built MS Roald Amundsen for polar waters and named her after the Norwegian who first reached the South Pole. She is the first of HX's two hybrid ships; her sister MS Fridtjof Nansen followed in 2020.

Inside, Scandinavian granite, oak, birch and wool. The Science Center is the heart of the ship, with lectures, a small library and workshops in photography and biology, and the Expedition Team. Three restaurants: Aune, where all meals are included, the informal Fredheim, and Lindstrøm, à la carte and included for suite guests.
A two-level indoor and outdoor Observation Deck, an infinity pool and hot tubs, a sauna, spa and fitness room.
why: James sailed her himself: the Antarctic Circle voyage in February and March 2020, calling at Ukraine's Vernadsky research station. The photographs on this page are his, from that voyage.
She sails the Drake Passage by sea, so her voyages reach further south than a flight allows: the Antarctic Circle Expedition attempts Marguerite Bay, south of 66 degrees.
HX's fare includes drinks with meals, gratuities, Wi-Fi and an expedition jacket, and flights between Buenos Aires and Ushuaia on her Antarctic voyages.

faqs: Has James sailed MS Roald Amundsen?
Yes. He sailed her on the Antarctic Circle voyage in February and March 2020, calling at Ukraine's Vernadsky research station. The photographs on this page are his.
How many guests does she carry?
Up to 490, as HX publishes. Every cabin is an outside cabin and half have private balconies.
Electric propulsion with batteries; HX says it cuts fuel use and CO2 emissions by 20 percent.
Which voyages does she sail in Antarctica?

Among others, HX's Highlights of Antarctica, Iconic Antarctica and the Antarctic Circle Expedition, from Buenos Aires via Ushuaia. The Antarctic Circle Expedition is filed here with its dates and fares.
